# AGENTS.md

This file orients AI and code agents working in this repository. It is intentionally short and points to the authoritative docs rather than restating them.

## What this project is

`@nikovirtala/projen-constructs` is a JSII library of opinionated [projen](https://projen.io) project types (TypeScript, JSII, and AWS CDK) that scaffold repositories with one shared configuration. It is written in TypeScript, compiled with JSII, and published to npm.

## The single most important rule

**This project generates itself with projen. Never hand-edit generated files.** Make configuration changes in `.projenrc.ts` (or the helpers in `src/` it uses), then run `pnpm projen` to regenerate everything else.

Generated files carry a `~~ Generated by projen` header or are listed in `.projen/files.json`. That set includes `package.json`, `tsconfig*.json`, `vitest.config.ts`, `biome.jsonc`, `mise.toml`, the GitHub workflows, `src/project-type.ts`, and `src/projects/*.generated.ts`. Any manual edit to those is overwritten on the next synth.

## Where things live

- `.projenrc.ts` — the project definition and the only place to make config-level changes.
- `src/components/` — reusable projen components (Vitest, TypeDoc, Mise, Homebrew, Colima, LocalStack, Lambda helpers). Edit directly.
- `src/config.ts`, `src/errors.ts`, `src/utils.ts`, `src/versions.json` — editable core sources.
- `src/projects/` — **generated** project classes. Do not edit.
- `src/project-generator.ts` and `src/project-type.ts` — code generation (`project-type.ts` is generated).
- `test/` — mirrors `src/`; unit tests in `test/**`, integration tests in `test/integration/`.
- `docs/` — hand-written guides plus `docs/api/` (generated TypeDoc output).

## Build and test

- Runtime: Node.js `>= 26.13.0` (managed via mise) and pnpm 12.
- `pnpm install` — install dependencies.
- `pnpm projen` — regenerate projen-managed files after editing `.projenrc.ts`.
- `pnpm build` — full synth, JSII compile, tests, and docs.
- `pnpm test` — Vitest unit tests with tsc type checking.
- `pnpm biome` — format and lint.

Note on older Node: the engines require Node `>= 26.13.0`, but the build and unit tests also run on Node 24 (npm just prints a harmless `EBADENGINE` warning). If you are in an environment where Homebrew cannot be installed, the projen `default` task and `pnpm build`/`pnpm projen` abort at the `install:homebrew` step; synthesize directly instead with `pnpm exec tsx --tsconfig test/tsconfig.json .projenrc.ts`, then compile with `pnpm exec jsii --silence-warnings=reserved-word`.
